channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Dow Jones futures advance as tech stocks rebound ahead of looming Nvidia earnings
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain by 0.18%, trading around 53,590 during European hours on Tuesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures advance by 0.28%, to trade near 7,690, and Nasdaq 100 futures rise by 0.58% to trade around 29,270.

item.title: Australian Dollar: CPI keeps RBA on hold bias – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects Australia’s July inflation data to show further moderation, consistent with no additional Reserve Bank of Australia hikes this year. He argues Governor Bullock is likely to stay hawkish, and even a small inflation surprise could lift AUD.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: MNB tone shift watched – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects Hungary's central bank, Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB), to cut its base rate by 25bp to 5.50%, but stresses that guidance will matter more for the Forint. While headline inflation has surprised on the downside, core and services pressures and energy risks persist.

item.title: Euro holds gains against Canadian Dollar on upbeat German IFO data
item.description: EUR/CAD extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.6160 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency cross remains stronger as the Euro (EUR) holds gains following the release of the German IFO business sentiment index data.

item.title: British Pound extends gains to fresh monthly peak, around mid-217.00s vs weaker Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross catches fresh bids on Tuesday and climbs to its highest level since July 30, around mid-217.00s during the first half of the European session.

item.title: Indian Rupee to remain under pressure due to elevated oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday.

item.title: US Dollar: Policy crosscurrents shape outlook – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that renewed policy uncertainty and Federal Reserve (Fed) reaction risks are constraining US Dollar (USD) gains, even as higher US real yields and a resilient US economy limit downside.

item.title: British Pound: Upside bias toward 1.3700 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe GBP/USD price action as range-bound intraday between 1.3615 and 1.3660, with momentum indicators neutral.

item.title: Germany’s IFO Business Climate Index improves again, arriving at 88.8 vs. 87.2 estimates
item.description: The German IFO Institute Business Climate Index improves again. The sentiment data arrives higher at 88.8 in August from 86.7 in July, revised higher from 86.6. The data also beats estimates of 87.2.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Rally pauses below 1.3700
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 1.3640 during the European trading session on Tuesday, even as the US Dollar Index (DXY) edges up, indicating strength in the British currency.

item.title: Gold: Path depends on yield regime shift – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny and Abdul-Ahad Lockhart highlight that Gold’s recent strength alongside USD weakness and higher US yields has not historically confirmed a debasement story.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Could surpass 1.3900 as break above 38.2% Fibo. comes into play
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen building on its recovery move from the 1.3730 region, or a three-month low touched last week, and gaining positive traction for the second straight day on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar falls as US Dollar gains on safe-haven demand
item.description: NZD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.5950 during the European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair faces downward pressure as the US Dollar (USD) gains strength from safe-haven demand driven by rising geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $68.50 despite revived debasement trading
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $68.40 per troy ounce during the European hours on Tuesday. However, Silver may regain ground as US government interventions in the bond market revive the debasement trade.

item.title: China says its cooperation with Iran should not be disrupted - Reuters
item.description: In a Reuters report on Tuesday, a Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Lin Jian, said that its cooperation with Iran is conducted within the framework of international law and should not be interfered with or disrupted when asked about new United States (US) sanctions related to Iran.

item.title: Gold remains depressed below $4,650 on firmer USD, Fed risks, Middle East tensions
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains on the back foot below $4,650 through the first half of the European session.

item.title: Copper: Tight inventories sustain price support – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey say Copper remains underpinned by tight LME inventories and strong US-bound flows.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar recovers modestly as markets assess developments in Mideast
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, August 25:

item.title: Euro remains depressed against British Pound despite upbeat German GDP figures
item.description: The Euro (EUR) extends losses for the fourth consecutive day against the British Pound (GBP) on Tuesday, testing weekly lows in the 0.8550 area despite the upward revision to German Q2 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) earlier in the day.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Export strains with strong CHF – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister analyses how the strong Swiss Franc (CHF) and an undervalued Chinese Yuan (CNY) are weighing on Switzerland’s export competitiveness.

item.title: WTI slides below $84.00 on firmer USD but US-Iran tensions limit deeper losses
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts fresh sellers following an intraday uptick to the $85.35 region and turns lower for the second straight day. The commodity slides below $84.00 during the early European session, though the downside potential seems limited.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges up as RBA keeps rate hike option quite possible
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades slightly higher against its major currency peers, except the US Dollar (USD), on Tuesday. In the European session, the Aussie pair is slightly down to near 0.7147.

item.title: Equities: Semiconductor selloff pressures Wall Street - Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists describe a cautious session for United States (US) equities, with the S&P 500 slipping as AI‑chip names sold off ahead of Nvidia’s earnings. While the equal‑weighted S&P approached record highs, headline indices were dragged lower by semiconductor weakness.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: US Dollar keeps crawling towards the key 160.00 area
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, in a low-volatility market, as investors await key data releases and the Jackson Hole symposium, due in the second half of the week, to make decisions.

item.title: US Dollar: Data weakness keeps downside risks elevated - TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists argue that the US Dollar (USD) has re-entered a bearish regime after the Treasury buyback announcement pushed the US Dollar Index (DXY) below its 200‑day SMA.

item.title: Euro: Further gains eyed toward 1.1800 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a constructive stance on EUR/USD despite recent consolidation around 1.1660. They still see room for upside toward 1.1725 in the coming weeks as long as support at 1.1630 holds.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Corrects further as US Dollar extends recovery
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, extending its corrective move from the four-day high of 1.1711 to near 1.1655 during the European trading session.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah struggles amid record deficit, external pressures
item.description: USD/IDR halts its three-day losing streak, trading around 17,770 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) struggles under the weight of cautious market sentiment driven by persistent external pressures.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises toward 186.00 after rebounding from ascending channel bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY appreciates after two days of gains, trading around 185.80 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the currency cross remains within the ascending channel pattern, signaling an ongoing bullish bias.
